title: OpenAI rolls out Lockdown Mode, an optional security setting designed to offer users advanced protection from prompt injection attacks by limiting some features (Igor Bonifacic/Engadget)
summary: Igor Bonifacic / Engadget: OpenAI rolls out Lockdown Mode, an optional security setting designed to offer users advanced protection from prompt injection attacks by limiting some features — The company says most users don't need to use the feature. — OpenAI has begun rolling out Lockdown Mode …
contentText:
Igor Bonifacic / Engadget :

OpenAI rolls out Lockdown Mode, an optional security setting designed to offer users advanced protection from prompt injection attacks by limiting some features   —  The company says most users don't need to use the feature.  —  OpenAI has begun rolling out Lockdown Mode …
